When an intern takes an approved leave, they remain responsible for completing all missed technical modules. Interns are granted compensatory working periods on designated weekend catch-up sessions to finalize pending notebooks and project submissions. Interns requiring planned leave must submit a formal written leave request via email to both their technical mentor and the HR coordinator (Rebecca Mam) at least 24 hours in advance. The email must specify the reason for absence, the expected duration, and a handover plan for any pending tasks. Planned leaves exceeding two consecutive working days require prior approval from the program manager.

In cases of medical emergencies or unexpected illness, interns must notify their mentor and HR before 10:00 AM on the day of absence via official messaging.
